About me

Hi, I’m Minahil Asif, a Computer Science graduate and an aspiring Data Analyst, currently pursuing an MS in Data Science at FAST-NUCES, Karachi. I’m passionate about exploring data, finding patterns, and turning raw data into insights that support better decisions.

I’m building my skills in Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Pandas and data visualization through hands-on projects and continuous learning. I also bring experience in data management, graphic design and content creation.

My goal is to apply my analytical and technical skills to real-world problems, create impactful data-driven solutions, and grow as a professional in data analytics.

How I work

The same loop on every project.

1. Frame the questionAgree what decision the dashboard supports before touching data.
2. Clean and modelFix types, nulls and duplicates, then shape tables for fast filtering.
3. MeasureDefine KPIs such as profit margin, churn rate and loss-making orders clearly.
4. Design for readersSlicers, drill-downs and a clear page order so anyone can explore.
5. RecommendTurn patterns into actions the business can take next.
